svg.aria-label: Front-left wheel on rock and parallel-cylinder clearance section

g.text: One wheel on the rock / travel pose
Front-left raised: 200.0 mm · chassis pitch 11.6° · roll 10.3°
Same kinematic pose as the model; arms held in travel position.
One centered arm/actuator per drum pair · blue: arms · orange: actuators · charcoal: CF rods · gray: wheels · tan: drums.
Support block shows the prescribed height; its shape and width are illustrative. Actual rock climbing is not simulated.
Contact model omits camber effects. The right section also needs the axial-width check; circles alone can over-reject.
Parallel-cylinder clearance is the default model. This section shows the closest pair for the illustrated front-left raise.
